new_jobs.title: Lead Project Manager - Client Onboarding
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  
See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.
  
  
**Overview**  
Bring your AdTech, MarTech, and retail media knowledge to Epsilon and help lead the end-to-end launch of digital solutions, platforms, and service programs for our clients.
  
  
The Project Manager plays a critical role in ensuring both the technology and supporting business operations are prepared for successful client launches. While our engineering and product teams build the technology, and our operational teams define and complete business processes, this role owns the coordinated project plan. It brings these workstreams together and ensures operational readiness throughout the organization.
  
  
This unique role combines project management, client success, and cross-functional coordination. You will partner with clients and internal collaborators to understand business goals. You will establish implementation plans, manage dependencies, coordinate readiness activities, and ensure all teams are aligned for a successful launch.
  
  
Success in this role requires developing and managing complex timelines. It also involves establishing achievements and communicating risks. The role demands driving decisions and holding collaborators accountable for deliverables in both technical and business workstreams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
**Relatable Experience/Backgrounds:**  

* Sales support, Project Management, Client Success, Account/Client Management, Engagement Management

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Lead the end-to-end project management of client program launches, including both AdTech platform implementation and operational readiness activities.
* Develop and maintain coordinated project plans that include achievements, timelines, dependencies, risks, decision points, and launch-readiness criteria.
* Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure teams are prepared to support new client programs upon launch.
* Exemplifies a hands-on approach to project management by managing multiple clients, cross teams, and tasks to achieve flawless delivery of our solutions to our clients
* Acts as liaison between cross teams, communicating unique business issues that require special attention during the end-to-end delivery process.
* Establish and manage project governance, including status reviews, updates for collaborators, decision tracking, and critical issue management.
* Identify dependencies between technical implementation activities and operational business requirements to minimize launch risk.
* Hold collaborators accountable to agreed-upon deliverables, timelines, and achievements while proactively addressing roadblocks and risks.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Epsilon AdTech solutions in all aspects of the role.
* Continually improves standard processes and provides recommendations to ensure that all accounts within area of responsibility meet the maximum quality setup standards prior to delivery.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Experience & Education**  

* 4-year bachelor's degree required
* Experience within AdTech, MarTech, Retail Media, Digital Media, or related technology-enabled service environments. (you do NOT need to possess technical experience within this)
* Experience managing complex implementations requiring coordination across technical, operational, and client-facing teams.
* Experience supporting the launch of client programs, platforms, services, or retail media solutions from initiation through go-live.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple partners, dependencies, and parallel workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

  
**Desired Qualifications**  

* Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and collaborator management skills, with experience engaging audiences from analysts to executive leadership.
* Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, and drive accountability across diverse partner groups.
* Demonstrated expertise in project planning and execution, including schedule management, achievement development, dependency tracking, risk mitigation, and launch readiness.
* Experience managing technology implementations and coordinating operational readiness activities to support successful client program launches.
* Strong ability to identify business opportunities, solve problems, and make decisions, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Ability to work autonomously while effectively coordinating and aligning multiple teams and workstreams.
* Experience within retail media, AdTech, MarTech, digital commerce, or related technology-enabled service environments preferred.

  
**Additional Information**  
**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.  
  
Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:  
  
**Our Culture:** https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon
  
  
**Life at Epsilon:** https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog
  
  
Epsilon has five values that define our culture and guide us as we create value for our clients, our people and consumers. We seek candidates who align with our company values, demonstrate them and make them meaningful in their day-to-day work:  

* **Act with integrity.** We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.
* **Work together to win together.** We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.
* **Innovate with purpose.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Digital Marketing Specialist**

**Full Time**

**Exempt**

**Union Position**

**About the Adler Planetarium**

The Adler Planetarium connects people to the universe and each other. Whether introducing a guest to the Ring Nebula, a neighborhood school to a community partner, a research team to a network of citizen scientists, or one staff member to another, the Adler's focus on meaningful connections dates back nearly a century.

Today, the museum typically hosts nearly 400,000 visitors annually and reaches millions more through youth STEAM programs, neighborhood skywatching events, online citizen science, and other outreach efforts. With the Adlers' support, people of all ages, backgrounds, and abilities gain the confidence to learn more about science and space discovery, and to explore their universe together under the sky we all share.

**The Position**

The Adler Planetarium is seeking a creative, organized Digital Marketing Specialist to join our dynamic team on Chicago's Museum Campus and own our owned channels. Reporting to the Associate Director of Marketing, the Digital Marketing Specialist manages the museum's social media presence, writes engaging cross-platform content, handles web publishing, oversees brand email newsletters, and tracks online performance metrics.

In this role, the Digital Marketing Specialist collaborates closely with team members across the institution—including science communicators and creative teams—to share astronomy stories and museum events. The primary focus is managing and expanding Adler's online community, driving visitor attendance, and cultivating lasting connections with museum members and guests. This is a union position with the Adler Planetarium Workers United, AFSCME Council 31.

This individual will also be responsible for:

**Social Media & Community Engagement (40%)**

* Plan, develop, and post content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Turn complex science topics and museum updates into clear, creative, platform-ready posts.
* Manage daily social media activities, build content schedules, and actively respond to comments and questions from our online audience.
* Work with internal partners to plan upcoming social campaigns and review past work.

**Email Marketing & Audience Outreach (30%)**

* Write, schedule, and send targeted email newsletters and automated messages to promote ticket sales, membership opportunities, and upcoming events.
* Use customer data to send relevant, timely messages to different subscriber groups.

**Website Publishing & SEO (15%)**

* Update and publish blog posts, event landing pages, and general website copy on the Adler website.
* Apply standard search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to help people easily find our web content through Google and AI search tools.
* Work with our creative and science teams to adapt scientific info and images for the website.

**Performance Tracking & Collaboration (10%)**

* Review monthly and quarterly content reports using Google Analytics (GA4), email stats, and social media data to see what works best.
* Use those results to suggest improvements for future marketing campaigns and website optimizations.
* Coordinate with the broader Marketing team to keep paid ads and organic posts aligned.

**Other Duties (5%)**

* Assist with additional marketing projects and events as assigned.

**The Work Schedule**

The typical work schedule for this position is 35 hours per week, from 9 AM to 5 PM, with a flextime and telecommuting option—2 days a week telecommuting and 3 days on-site at the museum

**The Compensation & Benefits (Full-Time)**

Base Pay Range: $60,000-65,000/yr

Work-Life Balance

* 35-hour workweek
* Eligible to accrue up to **12** vacation days per year to start
* 3 sick days as of date of hire (can accrue up to 6.5 days per year)
* 7 Adler paid holidays
* 4 Personal Holidays (Prorated for new hires starting after January 1st)
* Flexible Work Arrangements
* Paid Family Bereavement Leave & Jury Duty
* Paid Parental Leave

Competitive Health Coverage

* Medical, Dental, & Vision insurance
* Healthcare, Dependent Care & Commuter flexible spending accounts
* Adler Paid Short-Term Disability insurance

Retirement Savings Plan

* 403 (b) plan with Adler match
* Adler match is 100% vested immediately
* Eligible to enroll as of the date of hire

Network of Support through our EAP programs

* Resources to help address emotional, legal, and financial issues
* Face-to-face, telephonic, and web-based services
* Free subscription to the Calm Premium app

Employee Loan Program

Discounted Onsite Pro Onsite Free Entrance to Chicago area museums and cultural institutions

**The Person**

The museum is seeking a creative, data-minded storyteller who can translate complex astronomy topics into accessible, engaging online narratives across digital channels. The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive self-starter who balances multiple campaigns, manages daily content schedules, and collaborates seamlessly across cross-departmental teams. This individual brings an analytical mindset to performance tracking, using data insights and feedback to optimize engagement, inform content strategy, and foster meaningful connections with the Adler's community.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of relevant work experience
* 4+ years of hands-on experience in social media, digital writing, or digital marketing
* Strong writing and editing skills, with basic photo and short-form video editing abilities
* Demonstrated experience using major social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn) and marketing tools such as Sprout Social, Mailchimp, and Google Suite
* Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and standard search engine optimization (SEO) techniques
* Ability to analyze simple web, email, and social media reports to assess performance and drive content improvements
* Organized, detail-or
